drhp.business: KRONOX Lab Sciences manufactures High Purity Speciality Fine Chemicals, including Excipients and ingredients, High Purity Reagents, and Pharmaceutical, nutraceutical and Food Chemical products. The Company has long-term supply relationships with customers both in India and abroad, built through backward and forward integration.
drhp.expansion: Development of Unit IV at Dahej: the Company has already obtained all required Local and State department permissions (CETP, BEIL, GEB, Approval of Industrial Plan from GIDC) and Environmental Clearance from the Central Government. Work at Unit IV could not be started due to unforeseen circumstances, but new deadlines have been finalized — production is expected to start within two years and the whole unit to be functional within three years.

moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- customer lock-in: long-term supply relationship commitments with customers in India and abroad — evidence: "We also have long term relations with regards to supply commitments with our customers both in India and abroad."
- licence/regulatory: facility certified to multiple quality/regulatory standards enabling access to pharma, food and export-sensitive customers — evidence: facility certified FSSC 22000, GMP, GLP, ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018, and products certified KOSHER and HALAL where applicable

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue growing the High Purity Speciality Fine Chemicals product portfolio through world-class technological adaptations combined with a steady focus on backward and forward integration to remain a best-quality manufacturer.
- Develop Unit IV at Dahej to expand manufacturing capacity, having already obtained the required local/state permissions and Central Government Environmental Clearance.
